coverage.production: Cancel missile_construction_10 through missile_construction_14. Their timeout effects also require an enabled system. Already paid funds are not refunded; cancellation does not bill the unbuilt balance.
coverage.benefits: Remove satellite_system and Antarctic laboratory modifiers, clear leadership and deployed-service flags, zero cached space upkeep and production expense. Satellite modifier has a global remove_trigger and native setup cannot restore it during quarantine.
coverage.access: Hide the actual space_gui_ledger_button / icon_ledger_btn_1 pair and the former Antarctic Space Race ledger pair. Preserve adjacent PMCs, UN, cyber, counter-terrorism and military ledgers. Lock native space-programme and space-weapons access checks.

state_policy.international_work_orders: Clear both inbound manifest reservations and outbound crew/operational assignments for every country, including AI/hotjoin countries. Cancel pending offers and deferred payout caches.
state_policy.active_flights: No advancement, RNG draws, casualties, outcome awards or post-shutdown reports are generated by the system. Stored engineering and flight records remain archival; no unsafe resume path is provided.
retained: completed research and already awarded one-use research bonuses
historical prestige, first holders and accepted programme receipts
already spent money and earlier rewards
missile, satellite and queued-payload inventory arrays
ordinary economy, nuclear fuel, missile-site functions and inventory-inheritance bookkeeping
state_policy.new_player_or_load: The flag is saved globally and is never cleared by system initialization. Root guards prevent bootstrap and UI entry after load or a change in player control.
state_policy.already_displayed_events: An event already displayed by HOI4 cannot be unsent. It may be dismissed; acceptance and every consequential Space Race effect are blocked independently.
state_policy.scope_boundary: A runtime quarantine prevents gameplay and recurring execution. It cannot unload script files or repair a parse error that prevents HOI4 from loading the campaign.

implementation.native_modifications: Complete effect, GUI, decision-timeout and modifier blocks are patched with project markers. Upstream notices remain. Mixed conventional military functions are deliberately outside the orbital quarantine.

provenance.new_gc_control: Original project code added under the existing imp_gc_tools_decisions category. Existing GC identity and performance expansion use imp_gc_nation / imp_gc_tools_show_perf_decisions.
provenance.upstream_credits: Existing native files retain their embedded MD author notices; no ownership or licence over upstream code is claimed.
provenance.licence_or_permission: User authorized this in-game emergency feature. Standalone redistribution rights for inherited upstream material are unknown.
